creators.name: Department Of Immigration And Ethnic Affairs

dates.dateInformation: Time period covered by the data

descriptions.description: The Department of Immigration and Ethnic Affairs commissioned McNair Andersion Associates to conduct this poll of attitudes to immigration as part of the regular McNair Market Monitor for two weekends in June 1985. The immigration poll consisted of five questions concerning attitudes to the size of migrant intake, rights of family members to migrate, rights of successful business workers to migrate, the global approach to refugees, and the impact of migrants on unemployment. Background variables include household composition, country of birth, marital status, level of education, age and sex.

descriptions.description: The Australian Gallup Polls, commissioned by Australian Public Opinion Polls (The Gallup Method) cover the periods of 1943-1968 and 1975-1987. Australian Gallup Polls comprise two subseries: the earlier series conducted by Roy Morgan (1943-1968); and the later series by McNair Anderson Associates (1975-1983). Opinion polls in the earlier series were conducted on a regular basis by Roy Morgan and the current holding of this archive date from July 1943 to August 1968, a total of 89 polls. The data are also available from the Roper Centre, University of Connecticut, U.S.A, where they were originally deposited. This data file - collected from Survey 169, May 1, 1964 - includes attitudes to equal pay for women, weekend shopping, limits on serving alcohol, distribution of funds between goverment and church schools, penalties for killing a mentally retarded child, all-digit telephone numbers, fingerprintng, football pools, picture shows on Sundays, the Beatles, purchase of Japanese air force planes, and attitudes to sending forces to Borneo. Background variables included age, sex, economic classification, occupation, vote at last Federal election, car ownership, having a phone, state (and urban/rural classification), religion and migrant status.

descriptions.description: The Australian Gallup Polls, commissioned by Australian Public Opinion Polls (The Gallup Method) cover the periods of 1943-1968 and 1975-1987. Australian Gallup Polls comprise two subseries: the earlier series conducted by Roy Morgan (1943-1968); and the later series by McNair Anderson Associates (1975-1983).
